cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

mechanism: A judges each proposed remedy as a repeat of the same waiting pattern and imposes progressively larger dinner consequences.
confusable: D91 compares care contributions; D96 turns new disagreement into proof of a recurring pattern and increases penalties.
comparison: Missed calls and self-cooked meals differ from canceled family visits and taking over explanations.
seedUse: Retain D96-a battery/train comparison and B borrowed-phone offer becoming the reason A escalates from eating early to ending dinner service.
